headline: OpenAI accuses ex-employee of leaking plans to Apple
summary: OpenAI filed a claim in its trade-secrets lawsuit with Apple alleging a former employee took more than 100 files on unreleased product plans and presented them to senior Apple leadership.

claims.statement: OpenAI claims a former employee took more than 100 files on unreleased product plans before joining Apple.

sources.quote: OpenAI claims a former employee took more than 100 files related to its product plans before joining Apple.
